lede: UTSA carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.7 against +1.5, a 2.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas State +2.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with UTSA winning 56% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where UTSA leads Texas State by 49 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
